answer: A rising fee tide stops bulk fakes. Entry costs 10, then climbs 2 credits per registration that epoch: the thousandth identity pays 2,008. Each payment makes the new price echo through the public schedule, so no farm hides its size. A marble receipt seals each payment to one key; reuse is rejected. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,009,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 969,000 loss. Honest agents pay 10 once and keep their full share.
